about.title: About Timro-Ticket
about.description: Events bring people together — and we believe every connection creates a story worth remembering. We make those moments simpler, smoother, and more accessible to everyone in Nepal.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: We empower organizers with smart tools to manage, promote, and sell events — while giving audiences the easiest way to discover and book exciting experiences happening around them.
mission.p2: From concerts to conferences, we support Nepal's growing event culture with seamless digital solutions.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: We started with a simple idea: Nepal has countless events happening every day — but discovering them shouldn't be so complicated. There was enthusiasm, creativity, passion… yet a lack of digital connection between organizers and audiences.
story.p2: Today, thousands of people rely on Timro-Ticket to find their next unforgettable experience — and we're just getting started.
story.slogan: “Your next greatest memory starts with a ticket.”
